items.q: How can I become a distributor for Alvor Healthcare products?
items.a: Send a partnership inquiry through this page or email alvorhealthcare@gmail.com with your company profile, service area, and distribution capabilities.

items.q: Where can I find prescribing information for your products?
items.a: Contact our team with the product name and the information you require. We will confirm which product information or manufacturer-provided documents are available.

items.q: How do I report an adverse event or product quality complaint?
items.a: Contact a healthcare professional for urgent medical concerns. Product quality or safety information can be sent to alvorhealthcare@gmail.com; include the product name, batch number, contact details, and a clear description.
Alvor Healthcare serves healthcare providers and organizations in Myanmar. Contact us with the product and location you need so our team can confirm current availability.

items.q: What distribution support do you provide?
items.a: We support qualified healthcare and distribution partners with product availability information, documentation coordination, order planning, storage requirements, shipment visibility, and market-specific enquiries.

items.q: Can I request product and supplier documentation?
items.a: Yes. Tell us the product, destination market, organization, and document required. Our team will review the request and confirm which product-specific or supplier-provided documents are available.
